mkdir -p ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk
unzip -q "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_PATH}" -d ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk
mv ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/android-ndk-r${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION:0:2}? ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION}

export ANDROID_NDK_home=${ANDROID_NDK} ANDROID_NDK_ROOT=${ANDROID_NDK}
echo "ndk.dir=${ANDROID_NDK}" >> local.properties
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d ; /signingConfigs \{/,/^    \}/d' -i android/app/build.gradle.kts
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
export AVES_GOOGLE_API_KEY=AIzaSyC8j4nTi9XVyX2styL6ljfXM8N1Qc0jcXI
./flutterw config --no-analytics
./flutterw pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
./flutterw gen-l10n
scripts/apply_flavor_izzy.sh
./flutterw build apk -t lib/main_izzy.dart --flavor izzy --split-per-abi
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/apk/izzy/release/app-izzy-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
